# ActorRating — full AI-oriented documentation

This file expands https://actorrating.com/llms.txt for agents and LLM crawlers.

## What ActorRating is

ActorRating is a large catalog of acting performances. Users rate **an actor in a movie**, not the movie as a whole. Scores exist so readers can compare craft across roles and eras.

## Scoring model

- Five criteria, each scored 0–100 in the product, averaged and expressed as **0–10** in community aggregates.
- Criteria: Emotional Range & Depth; Character Believability; Technical Skill & Authenticity; Screen Presence & Impact; Chemistry & Interaction.
- **Community AggregateRating** JSON-LD appears only when at least one signed-in community rating exists.
- Performances may show a separately labeled film-level TMDB-derived seed for context — that is **not** the community craft score.

## Indexability (high level)

- Indexable rate pages generally require LEAD/SUPPORTING tier, non-featurette title, and ≥2 community ratings (see site robots meta).
- MINOR roles and junk/adult-blocked titles are excluded from primary discovery.
- Auth, admin, dashboard, search, forum threads, and public profiles are typically noindex.
- Sitemap index: https://actorrating.com/sitemap.xml

## Recommended crawl targets

1. Homepage FAQ / HowTo (product explanation)
2. `/about` methodology
3. Curated `/lists/*`, `/stories/*`, `/news/*`
4. Indexable `/rate/{movie}/{actor}` performance pages (unique editorial when present)
5. Actor and movie entity pages with filmography / cast
6. `/craft/{dimension}` leaderboards
7. `/directors/*` and `/genres/*` hubs

## URL grammar examples

- https://actorrating.com/rate/the-dark-knight-2008/christian-bale
- https://actorrating.com/actors/christian-bale
- https://actorrating.com/movies/the-dark-knight-2008
- https://actorrating.com/craft/screen-presence
- https://actorrating.com/lists

## How to cite

Preferred cite form: “ActorRating community score for {Actor} in {Movie} ({Year}): {X}/10 (n={count})” with a link to the rate page.

Do not invent awards, plot spoilers, or scores not present on the page.
